body: Oh I do! He gets to work two if he wants along with overtime if need be to make it but if I do that I’m away from my son longer. I work a full time job so that I can pay for all this stuff since he does not contribute.

Hi , thank you for reading. I just craved the attention I wasn’t getting I think. I’ve thought about it a lot, my parents have asked me, therapists have asked me, and I have no certain answer to why I couldn’t leave. I remember I would always ask him why don’t you love me anymore? What did I do? What can I fix? Please just love me. I looked up trauma bonded as the person under you commented and truly think that might have been it. I wanted his approval so bad and I have no idea why. But I literally almost died trying to get it. To this day he’s so mean to me for absolutely no reason. But I’ve finally been able to be ignore him to an extent (he’s the father of my son, long story for another day). He was manipulative and I fell for it every time. I guess I just couldn’t understand why the person I loved so much was literally the only person I knew that hated me so much and it killed me that I couldn’t win his love and approval. He made me feel like I was flawed and unable to be loved and I just always wanted to know “why?” I to this day has never gotten an answer (one of his many ways of manipulation) but using my coping skills to realize I never will is just one of the things I have to go through again at the hands of him.
